english.title: Allow a vehicle / animal / thing to be on Heathrow Airport after presence had been forbidden
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) allowed

(A)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..),]_
(C)_[a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..),]_

to remain on Heathrow Airport at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), after its presence on the airport had been forbidden by **(..SPECIFY NAME..),

(D)_[a constable,]_
(E)_[an Airport Official,]_

in accordance with byelaw 3.10 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3.10 and 2.2 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
